performance.title: Performance
performance.description: These metrics validate the performance of your web application

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: These checks ensure your web application is accessible

first-contentful-paint.title: First Contentful Paint
first-contentful-paint.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted.

largest-contentful-paint.title: Largest Contentful Paint
largest-contentful-paint.description: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) marks when the largest text or image is painted.

total-blocking-time.title: Total Blocking Time
total-blocking-time.description: Sum of all time periods between FCP and Time to Interactive

cumulative-layout-shift.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
cumulative-layout-shift.description: Sum of all individual layout shift scores

speed-index.title: Speed Index
speed-index.description: Speed Index shows how quickly the contents of a page are visibly populated.
